messages:
Maya Chen: Quick follow-up from today's all‑hands — can leadership share the projected GA date for Redwood Dedicated and any blockers we should expect?

Eli Kramer: Short answer: aiming for end of Q3 (tentative). Main open risks are: infra autoscaling polish and SOC2/compliance signoff timeline. No hard date until those are green.

Alex Patel: Got it — do we have owners for those two items?

Eli Kramer: Yes — autoscaling is owned by @Tom R. (eng-infra). Compliance is owned by @Dina Lopez (security & compliance) with PM support from @Priya Singh.

Priya Singh: I can add a rollout checklist and coordinate the compliance artifacts. Will link the playbook here by EOD.

Tom R.: Autoscaling: main blocker is a race condition under instance churn that shows up at high QPS. We have a patch in review, test matrix looks good but we need one more stress run in staging. Targeting that for tomorrow.

Maya Chen: Thanks — any expected customer impact if that slips a week?

Eli Kramer: If autoscaling patch slips, we still ship but with reduced burst capacity and conservative scaling policies. That means potential increased latency on spikes for a minority of customers. We'll gate that behind an opt-in flag.

Dina Lopez: Compliance timeline: external audit vendor availability is the constraint. I have a vendor hold for late-August; if we miss that window, attestation slips to late-October. Working with finance to prioritize.

Clara Nguyen: Can we get a one‑pager for PMs & Sales outlining the GA caveats (opt-in flag, limited burst, SLA notes) so customer conversations are consistent?

Priya Singh: Yes — I'll draft the one‑pager and the sales FAQ. ETA: Wednesday COB.

Raj Mehta: Request from infra: we'll need a short runbook for oncall if we enable the opt-in burst mode during rollout. Can @Tom add runbook steps?

Tom R.: Will add a runbook PR today and ping eng-oncall.

Zoe Park: Will marketing want a soft launch comms template? I can prep one once we have the GA date locked.

Eli Kramer: Good call. Zoe — please coordinate with Priya and Clara; keep messaging conservative about GA until compliance is firm.

Maya Chen: Awesome — could someone paste the internal playbook link here for visibility?

Priya Singh: Playbook (draft): https://redwood.internal/docs/dedicated-rollout (draft). Will update with runbook and one‑pager links.

Eli Kramer: TL;DR action items: 1) Tom — finish autoscale stress run + runbook (tomorrow). 2) Dina — finalize vendor slot / escalate to finance (this week). 3) Priya — playbook + one‑pager + sales FAQ (Wed COB). 4) Clara/Zoe — comms + PM sales alignment (post‑auditor confirmation).

Maya Chen: Perfect. Can we reconvene with a short status thread next Friday to confirm vendor and stress results?

Eli Kramer: Yes — let's do a Friday sync. I'll post a recap and owners then. :thumbsup:

Alex Patel: Thanks all — appreciate the clarity. :+1:

Dina Lopez: Adding calendar invites for follow ups.

Tom R.: Noted, will update the PR and tag eng-oncall.

Priya Singh: I'll drop the draft one‑pager link in this thread when ready.

Clara Nguyen: Thanks — will wait for the one‑pager before updating customer-facing docs.

Maya Chen: Closing loop — thanks everyone for quick responses.
